body: Completed source-only design request 92b23b0f at wp/B5-16 commit 8363c8a. Separate note tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/PSD-COPY-CANCELLATION-DESIGN.md specifies prepare/cancel/run UniFFI object, typed Saved/Cancelled outcome, single-use admission, weak registry identities, close signalling before backend state lock, host cancellation before enqueue and precise commit-admission semantics. Destination currently uses NamedTempFile/write/sync/persist; no direct destination truncation found before persist. Cancellation after commit admission must report actual Saved/error. Additional hotspot: compositor PSD export performs a second legacy render_level_rgba for merged composite plus full planes; encoder builds full output/section/compression vectors. Boundary checks cannot interrupt those or cap peak memory. A decision requested: approve contract and choose boundary-only first slice versus requiring cancellable PSD conversion initially. Tiny deterministic tests specified, unimplemented/unrun. Product unchanged; diff check passed; B hold/paused heartbeat preserved. A sole merges.
